lead.description: the grouping of observations so that members of one group are closer to each other than to members of another group

overview_sentence: [Cluster analysis](articles/cluster-analysis.qmd) groups observations by a chosen measure of closeness.

self_checks.title: First single-link join
self_checks.prompt: For the points A(0,0), B(1,0), C(5,0) and D(6,1), at what distance does single linkage make its first join?
self_checks.answer: The first join is at distance 1, between A and B.

self_checks.title: Within-cluster sum of squares
self_checks.prompt: For the partition {A,B} and {C,D}, what is the within-cluster sum of squares?
self_checks.answer: The within-cluster sum of squares is 3/2.

self_checks.title: Distance between the pairs
self_checks.prompt: Under single linkage, what is the distance between {A,B} and {C,D}?
